summary: This topic explains how to define specific routes for each vehicle, including associated pickup/drop-off points, timings, and charges. It also covers options for copying routes from previous sessions and bulk uploading pickup points.
steps: To create a new route, click 'New Vehicle Route'.
Select the 'Vehicle' (bus) assigned to this route from the dropdown.
(Optional) Use 'Skip Installment' to exclude transport charges for specific fee installments.
Enter the 'Amount' (charge) for this pickup point (e.g., 2000).
To upload pickup points in bulk:
Fill the Excel with 'Pickup Point Name', 'Amount', 'Pick Up Time', 'Drop Time'. (Pick Up Time and Drop Time are non-mandatory in Excel).
Choose the filled Excel file and click 'Submit'.
business_rules: The 'Copy from Session' feature allows replicating routes from a previous academic session.
important_notes: An error file will be generated during bulk upload if mandatory information (e.g., amount) is missing in the Excel.
Longitude and Latitude are used for GPS tracking systems.
